0022600126.text: The Utah Jazz (1-2, 11th in the West) host the Memphis Grizzlies (2-0, 5th in the West) in the Jazz's fourth game of the 2026-27 season, with Utah having lost its last game. Utah is missing Jusuf Nurkic (out, foot strain) and Trey Alexander (out, knee bruise), while Memphis is without Zach Edey (out, ankle), and Cedric Coward and Karim Lopez (day-to-day, with Lopez's knee bruise). The Jazz trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after a 123-103 loss in Memphis on October 21, and the teams split their 2025-26 series 2-2.
